events.title: ESMO · Phase 3 intismeran melanoma data presentation
events.time: 7:30 a.m. Pacific / 10:30 a.m. EDT / 4:30 p.m. CEST
events.summary: October 24, 7:30 a.m. Pacific: INTerpath-001 Phase 3 adjuvant melanoma results are scheduled for an ESMO Presidential Symposium. Clinical data presentation, distinct from the later investor webcast; the schedule does not establish positive results.
events.note: Captured October 9–21 contracts expire after this scheduled presentation. Clinical-data risk can affect price sharply in either direction. Historical FARCRY and NAUTILUS captures include puts as well as calls; today's WF PSU capture is call-side. Date overlap does not establish intent.

events.title: ESMO · Moderna investor webcast
events.time: 10 a.m. Pacific / 1 p.m. EDT / 7 p.m. CEST
events.summary: October 24, 10 a.m. Pacific: Moderna hosts an investor webcast following the ESMO scientific presentation. A non-earnings oncology investor event, separate from the earlier data session. The November 6 earnings call is excluded from RAMBO; November 6 option expirations still carry that earnings risk.
events.note: October 21 November 6 $330 calls and November 27 $310 calls both extend past this webcast. November 6 expiration coincides with the announced earnings date. November 27 contracts also span November 12 Analyst Day. No causal or profitability claim.

events.title: Analyst Day
events.summary: November 12 Analyst Day is listed in Moderna's SEC-filed company release. Start time and detailed agenda are not yet verified. This is a planned investor event, separate from earnings and ESMO. November 6 earnings occur before this event and remain an intervening risk.
events.note: November 27 $310 calls span this event; November 6 $330 calls expire beforehand and do not match Analyst Day. Earlier captured November 20 and January–April 2027 contracts span the date too. November 6 earnings precede Analyst Day and can dominate the intervening price move.
